task.title: Add an event
task.shortdesc: Record something that happened in a person's life, something that lasted for years, or an event of your own kind.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

stepresult.p: The sheet named opens. Under Add an event to the person it lists the kinds of event.

info.p: The other choices are forms for a census, a baptism record, a burial record and a marriage register entry. Use one only when you have seen that record. explains them.

step.cmd: In , choose the kind of event, such as .

info.p: The list is long. It also has and .

step.cmd: Enter the date and the place.

info.p: For something that lasted, turn on and type a period, such as from 25 February 1820 to 7 June 1861. explains the choices.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The event shows in the list of events for that person.

result.p: For a kind of event that is not on the list, choose in . Then type your own word in , such as Publication. The list of events shows Event. The word you typed shows when you open the event.
